```{r}

get_aphia_data <- function(taxa_vector) {
  # Query the WoRMS database for multiple names
  # marine_only = TRUE filters out non-marine records if desired
  records_list <- wm_records_names(name = taxa_vector, marine_only = FALSE)
  
  # Map results back to the original queried names safely
  mapped_results <- map2_df(taxa_vector, records_list, function(original_name, record_df) {
    
    # Handle cases where the name wasn't found in WoRMS
    if (is.null(record_df) || nrow(record_df) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        scientificName = original_name,
        AphiaID = NA_integer_,
        accepted_AphiaID = NA_integer_,
        valid_name = NA_character_,
        status = "not found"
      ))
    }
    
    # Extract the preferred record (prioritizing the officially 'accepted' status if multiple rows return)
    preferred_record <- record_df %>% 
      arrange(desc(status == "accepted")) %>% 
      slice(1)
    # Return matched information
    tibble(
      scientificName = original_name,
      AphiaID = as.integer(preferred_record$AphiaID),
      accepted_AphiaID = as.integer(preferred_record$valid_AphiaID),
      valid_name = preferred_record$valid_name,
      status = preferred_record$status
    )
  })
  
  return(mapped_results)
}

# Run the function on the species list
AphiaIDs_new_taxa <- get_aphia_data(needs_aphia$scientificName)
AphiaIDs_check_taxa <- get_aphia_data(abundance$scientificName)

# TODO: print a warning message

write_csv(AphiaIDs_check_taxa, "output/AphiaIDs.csv")
```

```{r}

AphiaIDs_new_taxa <- select(AphiaIDs_new_taxa, scientificName, AphiaID)
abundance_ids <- left_join(abundance, AphiaIDs_new_taxa, by = "scientificName")

abundance_ids <- abundance_ids |> 
  mutate(AphiaID = case_when(is.na(AphiaID.x) ~ AphiaID.y,
                                !is.na(AphiaID.x) ~ AphiaID.x)) |>
  select(-AphiaID.x, -AphiaID.y)

abundance_ids <- abundance_ids |>
  relocate(AphiaID, .after = scientificNameID) |>
  mutate(scientificNameID = case_when(is.na(scientificNameID) ~ paste0("urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:", AphiaID),
                                      !is.na(scientificNameID) ~ scientificNameID)) |>
  mutate(scientificNameID = case_when(is.na(scientificName) ~ NA, TRUE ~ scientificNameID))

```


```{r}

# get Family
#classification <- wm_classification_(abundance_ids$AphiaID)
family_list <- filter(wm_classification_(abundance_ids$AphiaID), rank == "Family")
family_list <- family_list |>
  rename(AphiaID_record = id) |>
  rename(family_ID = AphiaID) |>
  rename(family_record = scientificname) |>
  rename(AphiaID = AphiaID_record)

family_list$AphiaID <- as.numeric(family_list$AphiaID)

family_list <- unique(family_list)

```

```{r}

# join with abundance data frame
abundance_fam <- left_join(abundance_ids, family_list, by = 'AphiaID')

abundance_fam <- abundance_fam |>
  relocate(c(family_ID, rank, family_record), .before = family)

abundance_fam <- abundance_fam |>
  mutate(family = case_when(is.na(family) ~ family_record,
                            !is.na(family) ~ family))

abundance_fam <- abundance_fam[order(abundance_fam$family, abundance_fam$scientificName, abundance_fam$verbatimIdentification),]

abundance_fam <- abundance_fam |> select(-family_ID, -rank, -family_record)

```

```{r}

# replace na with zero in count columns 
abundance_fam <- abundance_fam |> 
  mutate(across(6:last_col(), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) 
# |>  replace_na(list(family = "", scientificName = "", scientificNameID = ""))

write_csv(abundance_fam,'nes-lter-trawl-transect-count-v3.csv', na = "NaN")
```

Read metadata 

## 2025

```{r}

# provide column names for new trawl metadata
metaheaders25 <- c(
  "cruise",
  "cast",
  "event",
  "no_of_jars", 
  "jar_no_processed",
  "eventDateStart",
  "eventDateEnd",
  "depth_tow",
  "station",
  "percent_preserved",
  "decimalLatitudeStart",
  "decimalLongitudeStart",
  "time_in_water",
  "depth_bottom",
  "time_target_depth_start",
  "time_target_depth_stop",
  "max_wire_out",
  "vessel_tow_speed",
  "time_exit_water",
  "decimalLatitudeEnd",
  "decimalLongitudeEnd",
  "cod_end_fullness",
  "preparations",
  "processing_notes")

meta_25 <- read_csv(('input/metadata2025.csv'), col_names = metaheaders25)
meta_25 <- meta_25[-1,]
meta_25$preparations <- gsub(",", ";", meta_25$preparations)
meta_25$processing_notes <- gsub(",", ";", meta_25$processing_notes)

# define headers for columns in desired order
metaheaders <- c(
  "cruise",
  "cast",
  "event",
  "eventDateStart",
  "eventDateEnd",
  "station",
  "depth_bottom",
  "depth_tow",
  "decimalLatitudeStart",
  "decimalLongitudeStart",
  "decimalLatitudeEnd",
  "decimalLongitudeEnd",
  "time_in_water",
  "time_exit_water",
  "time_target_depth_start",
  "time_target_depth_stop",
  "max_wire_out",
  "vessel_tow_speed",
  "cod_end_fullness",
  "no_of_jars", 
  "jar_no_processed",
  "percent_preserved",
  "preparations",
  "processing_notes")
# reorder columns 
meta_25 <- meta_25[, metaheaders]

meta_25$eventDateStart <- mdy(meta_25$eventDateStart)
meta_25$eventDateEnd <- mdy(meta_25$eventDateEnd)

meta_25$time_target_depth_start <- str_pad(meta_25$time_target_depth_start, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0") 

meta_25$time_target_depth_stop <- str_pad(meta_25$time_target_depth_stop, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0")

meta_25 <- meta_25 |> mutate_at(c("cast",
                                  "depth_bottom",
                                  "decimalLatitudeStart",
                                  "decimalLongitudeStart",
                                  "decimalLatitudeEnd",
                                  "decimalLongitudeEnd",
                                  "max_wire_out",
                                  "vessel_tow_speed",
                                  "no_of_jars",
                                  "percent_preserved"), as.numeric)


meta_prev <- read_csv(('v2/nes-lter-trawl-transect-metadata-v2.csv'))
meta_prev$eventDateStart <- meta_prev$eventDate
meta_prev$eventDateEnd <- meta_prev$eventDate
meta_prev <- meta_prev[, metaheaders]

meta_prev$time_target_depth_start <- as.character(meta_prev$time_target_depth_start)
meta_prev$time_target_depth_stop <- as.character(meta_prev$time_target_depth_stop)

meta_prev$time_target_depth_start <- str_pad(meta_prev$time_target_depth_start, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0")
meta_prev$time_target_depth_stop <- str_pad(meta_prev$time_target_depth_stop, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0")

meta <- rbind(meta_prev, meta_25)

meta$time_target_depth_start <- left(meta$time_target_depth_start, 5)
meta$time_target_depth_stop <- left(meta$time_target_depth_stop, 5)

# clean up two time entries from v2 that were missing colon
meta <- meta |>
  mutate(time_in_water = case_when(time_in_water == "1419" ~ "14:19", TRUE ~ time_in_water)) |>
  mutate(time_exit_water = case_when(time_exit_water == "1537" ~ "15:37", TRUE ~ time_exit_water))

meta$time_in_water <- str_pad(meta$time_in_water, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0")
meta$time_exit_water <- str_pad(meta$time_exit_water, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0")

# round wire out
meta$max_wire_out <- round(meta$max_wire_out, 0)

write_csv(meta,'nes-lter-trawl-transect-metadata-v3.csv')

```

Read the Excel metadata template and generate text templates used by
EMLassemblyline

```{r}
excel_to_template(here('trawl-transect-info-v3'), 'nes-lter-trawl-transect-v3', rights='CCBY', file_type=".md")

sheet_to_tsv('trawl-transect-info-v3.xlsx', 'ColumnHeadersCount', 'attributes_nes-lter-trawl-transect-count-v3.txt')

sheet_to_tsv('trawl-transect-info-v3.xlsx', 'ColumnHeadersMeta', 'attributes_nes-lter-trawl-transect-metadata-v3.txt')

sheet_to_tsv('trawl-transect-info-v3.xlsx', 'CategoricalVariables', 'catvars_nes-lter-trawl-transect-count-v3.txt')         

template_taxonomic_coverage(
  path = here(),
  data.path = here(),
  taxa.table = "nes-lter-trawl-transect-count-v3.csv",
  taxa.col = "scientificName",
  taxa.name.type = "scientific",
  taxa.authority = c(9, 3, 11),
  empty = FALSE,
  write.file = TRUE
)

```
Generate the package and insert the parent project node into the resulting EML

```{r}
# generate EML
pkg_id <- 'knb-lter-nes.34.3'

make_eml(here(),
         dataset.title='Zooplankton and micronekton abundance using an Isaacs-Kidd Midwater trawl on Northeast U.S. Shelf Long Term Ecological Research (NES-LTER) Transect cruises, ongoing since 2023',
         data.table= c('nes-lter-trawl-transect-count-v3.csv', 'nes-lter-trawl-transect-metadata-v3.csv'),
         data.table.description= c('Zooplankton and micronekton abundance', 'Net tow metadata'),
         data.table.name = c('nes-lter-trawl-transect-abundance-v3', 'nes-lter-trawl-transect-metadata-v3'),
         temporal.coverage = temporal_coverage(meta$eventDateStart),
         geographic.description = "NES-LTER Transect",
         geographic.coordinates = geographic_coordinates(meta$decimalLatitudeStart, meta$decimalLongitudeStart),
         maintenance.description = "ongoing",
         user.id = "NES",
         user.domain = "LTER",
         package.id = pkg_id)

project_insert(pkg_id, "parent_project_NESI-II.txt")

issues()
```
